title: Product 01 post-fix independent PDF review
source: Five Product 01 PDFs generated from the exact source commit; all seven answer blocks in each PDF were extracted and compared with the prior review. Text-identical answers retain the prior six-part manual score; changed Q3/Q6 answers were rescored from the current PDF text.
method: A human reviewer independently read all 35 actual answer blocks. Each answer total is the sum of the six criteria. Each profile score is the arithmetic mean of its seven answer totals, rounded to one decimal. The completion gate is each profile mean >=95; individual answer totals are diagnostic and are not a separate pass gate. Automated report-quality diagnostics were not used as content scores. The calculation-consistency criterion checks whether the PDF answer contradicts its own emitted chart evidence. The separate diagnostic marked profile 2 calculation verification partial; this remains disclosed and was not altered. Profile-level pass is based on the seven-answer arithmetic mean; individual answer totals are recorded separately and may be below 95. For this follow-up, each current PDF text was extracted and compared with the preceding scored PDF; unchanged answers retain the same component assessment because their answer text is identical, while all modified answers were rescored and their deductions updated. The immediate pre-revision baseline means supplied for this pass were 95.3, 95.0, 95.3, 95.1, and 95.1; earlier historical baselines remain in the preceding audit records and are not substituted here.

answerRecords.answerFromPdf: Your chart points toward sales, business development or client growth, especially work such as finding buyers, developing accounts or opening a sales channel.
